description: This file defines functions to generate JUnit XML reports for testing purposes, specifically formatting test output for integration with Azure Pipelines and Git's test suite. It includes functions to start and finalize test outputs and test cases, handle different test results, and encode XML attributes.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes the JUnit XML report for a test script, setting up directory and filename based on the test script's name, and opening the XML test suite element.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Marks the start time of an individual test case execution.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes the output for a test case, handling different result types (ok, failure, fixed, broken, skip), and writes the corresponding <testcase> element into the JUnit XML report.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Completes the entire test report by adjusting the total time, closing XML elements, and cleaning up.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Helper function to write lines into the JUnit XML file, optionally truncating the file.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes input strings into XML-compatible entities, used for safe inclusion in XML attributes.
